name: save_app_state
reason: Writes app-state.json, full writes included, from main's copy; a satellite writes its allowed keys with patch_app_state_keys.

name: set_active_team_for_wave
reason: Sets the one global active team that MCP resolves against; main owns it.

name: remove_watch
reason: Detaches a repo watch that main registered.

name: push_viewer_state
reason: Replaces MCP's view of the viewer with the caller's tabs; that view is main's.

name: start_watching
reason: Starts a team watch under the global watcher lifecycle sequence; main keeps the teams it watches.

name: stop_watching
reason: Stops a team watch under the global watcher lifecycle sequence; main keeps the teams it watches.

name: reconfigure_warm_pool
reason: Drains and refills the one global terminal warm pool.

name: set_terminal_shell_override
reason: Changes the shell of the one global warm pool and drains it.
